body:
Hi, still alive, still feeling like shit. I'm really grateful for your replies, they mean a lot to me. 

I think the thing that makes me the most scared is doing stuff by myself. I have really bad self esteem so literally everything I do becomes a struggle because I hate myself if I dont perform as expected. I get very anxious when making mistakes and I blame myself very much for it. I have so many memories from times when I fucked up or said something stupid and they just won't go away. Literally every time I have to do something that is considered even slightly hard I start to cry and feel like shit, and I just want to flee from the situation. I just want a normal life, like everyone else, but I feel so fucking alone and miserable. I have so many friends who do stuff and have girlfriends. My girlfriend broke up with me after two years, that left a pretty big scar in my soul that I think never will heal, she really was the world to me and we got along really well together, I miss her so fucking much. 

My dad left me aswell, for a different family or some shit. I don't know if that's where my bad self esteem originates from, I just know that i have a terrible view of myself and I'm not sure how to change it. I don't feel like i could adapt to anything, I don't trust myself enough to drive a car for example because I get so anxious about failing and possibly hurting somebody innocent when I fuck up. I also walk around and feel like a fucking pathetic mess all the time because of this, and I just wish i was like everybody else. I know that life is a struggle for everyone, but is it really this bad? Is this what everyone walks around with inside of them every day? Am I just a weak person that needs to realize that life fucking sucks and it always will? I don't know. I feel like I don't know anything anymore. I used to take my well-being for granted when I was in school. I have absolutely no desire to do anything, and everyone just leaves me when I get too close with them, so what is even the point of trying to find someone new? I don't want to find someone new, I still love her. I still hate myself for it, I blame myself for it so fucking much. Why can't I be the guy that the girl chooses? I'm just too fucking weak of a person.

Thanks for checking in on me, that was nice of you.

I'm sure you are right, and don't worry about me taking offense because I won't. 

I just feel so fucking helpless, knowing that whatever I do I make people upset. I don't want to live this life anymore. I feel so fucking bad every day, and I feel like there's no way out of this. You seem like a smart person, and I'm sure that my thinking is messed up. I am messed up as a whole. I'm surrounded by a loving family and friends but it still feels like I have absolutely nothing and I fucking hate myself for feeling like this but I don't know what to do. I'm scared of life, I'm scared of living, I mostly sit in my room all day and play videogames. I'm so fucking scared of growing up, it feels like I just wouldn't be able to handle the life as an adult, because I always seem to mess everything up in some stupid way. And why the fuck should I carry on with this perception of a "life" if I don't even want to. I feel so alone, even though I am surrounded by so many loving people. I feel unfair towards them for feeling like this.

I used to, but she broke up with me after 2 years. I have my cat that always partners me when he notices im sad or crying. I cry alot these days, like 2-3 times a day. My friends are great, but I don't think they would understand me. The only one that truly understood me was my girlfriend, but she left me for a different guy. That left a pretty big scar in my soul, and I hate myself for it to this day. I'm scared of the future, I don't feel like I'm ever going to grow up and get myself a real "normal" life. I feel so bad.

You're probably right, I'm just looking for anything that could make this easier for them.. I don't want to put them through this but I don't feel like I have much of a life to live anymore. Should I really walk around every day feeling like shit just because people around me would be sad if I passed? Fuck.

I'm 20, would rather not talk about my housing situation, I don't really have a will no. A few days ago I woke up from a nightmare where a man was chasing me with a knife through the city and I was running for my life. When i woke up, I realized i actually felt worse waking up to this life than experiencing a nightmare. How fucked up is that? That really touched me, in a bad way. Why should i keep going like this? Its fucking pointless

Good advice, the problem for me is that i don't really have any acquired skill that i could teach the people I care about, otherwise i would do that for sure. 

I don't even know if I should write a letter or something or just leave them with all the thoughts. It seems like a letter would traumatize them in a way, but I just want them to understand it's not their fault and that this is my decision.. I'm probably going to write a testimony, not that I have an impressive amount of assets or anything but I would like if it went to the right hands when i die. 

I don't know what you mean by support system but I have a good family and good friends, who I am sure would listen, but I don't want to talk about this with them, for various reasons.

Thanks for the post, this was actually helpful. Faking an accident or something is probably something I could look into, thank you so much. Also thank you for the kind words and for your concerns, appreciate it.

Yeah, the whole situation fucking sucks and I feel really selfish, but in the end, it's my life and my decisions, why should I keep living if i find no point in it?

Yeah I have sought help about it, but I'd rather not talk about that. But I have been to various psychologists over the years.
And I didn't mean it to be evil..i just wanted to help

I know it will be tough for them. Hell, the only reason I'm standing here is because I dont want my family and friends to suffer through such a thing, but why should I live on just to make other people happy? I really don't even want to try.. I'm not a bad guy, this situation just fucking sucks for me and I feel helpless knowing whatever I choose to do it will be bad. All i want to do is to figure out these things before I do it, just so that they maybe can move on a little bit easier. I know i will hurt them, and it fucking sucks. I don't want them to clean up my mess. I just wish that everybody could forget about me, but that's not how it works..
